login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: XControl Panel
login.mfaHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

dashboard.intro: XCP is in early development. Hosting features (accounts, domains, email, DNS) arrive in the next phase.
dashboard.enable2fa: Protect this login with two-factor authentication.

security.title: Login & security
security.forcedPassword: Your password must be changed before you can continue.

password.title: Change password
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, or enter the key by hand:
twofa.confirm: Enter a code from the app to finish:
twofa.recoveryHelp: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe; they will not be shown again.
twofa.disableHelp: Enter your password to turn off two-factor authentication.

errors.invalid_code: That code is wrong or was already used.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
errors.login_disabled: This login is suspended. Contact your provider.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.csrf_failed: Security check failed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
errors.in_use: It is still in use and cannot be deleted.
errors.domain_taken: Another account already uses this domain.
errors.bad_status: Not possible in the account's current status.
errors.verification_required: Prove that you control this domain first (see below).
errors.limit_reached: Your package allows no more of these.
errors.primary_domain: The primary domain belongs to the account and cannot be removed.
errors.has_dependents: Remove its subdomains and aliases first.
errors.redirect_exists: This domain already has a redirect for that path.

packages.title: Packages
packages.name: Name
packages.unlimitedHint: Leave a field empty for unlimited.

limits.php_versions_hint: Comma-separated, like 8.2, 8.3. Empty: all installed versions.

featureLists.title: Feature lists
featureLists.help: A feature list decides which parts of the panel accounts on a package can use.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.usernameHint: Lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter. This is also the Linux user name.
accounts.mustChange: Require a new password at next login
accounts.passwordSet: Password changed. The account was signed out everywhere.
accounts.terminateHelp: This deletes the account, its Linux user and all files in its home folder. Type the username to confirm.

domains.title: Domains
domains.noAccount: This login has no hosting account.
domains.name: Domain
domains.docrootHint: Inside your home folder. Leave empty for the suggested one; it is created if missing.

help.addon: Another website with its own folder.
help.sub: A name below one of your domains, such as blog.example.com, with its own folder.
help.alias: Another name that shows the same website as one of your domains.

domains.confirmDelete: Remove {{name}}? Its files stay in your home folder.

verify.intro: Another account on this server uses a domain under the same name. To show that {{name}} is yours, add this DNS record where the domain is managed:
verify.retry: DNS changes can take a few minutes to appear. Then try again.

redirects.title: Redirects
redirects.keepPath: Keep the rest of the path (/old/page goes to destination/page)
